meta.description: GET /webhook/app (pages) and POST /webhook/app-action (actions), HTTP Basic login (CONTROL_USER / CONTROL_PASSWORD). Clients, campaigns (create, launch, pause/resume/stop), leads (exclude, rewrite), replies (approve/edit/reject, sort), meetings, tasks, system. Actions that Slack also offers run through 11_slack_actions (control-action), so both behave identically. Local only: the tunnel lets only Slack clicks through.
